changed_factors: Advance RHBI from rhbi-v9 to rhbi-v10 under one global clock-free, schedule-free, shape-gate-free recipe via two orthogonal metric-space mechanisms: (1) inter-mode valley 96th-quantile tail-spill thermal residual channel (rhbi_tail_spill_gain=1.8), which tracks a dedicated signed schema-3 EMA channel (rhbi_ema_tail) of the two-sample 96th-quantile fake-to-real nearest-neighbor precision excess strictly on continuous-prior multi-mode supports with deep inter-mode valleys (cyclic-midpoint horizon ratio nu_val > rho=3.0, remaining exact 0.0 on discrete ParticlePrior codebooks and on unimodal, overlapping, or low-bit quantized MXFP8/NVFP4 supports) so the Kantorovich-Hellinger thermal controller holds s_t=1.0 until the last <8% inter-mode bridge particles clear into the modes before cooling cleanly under a near-zero null tail bias; and (2) wide-span macro-simplicial manifold settling (rhbi_simplex_macro_settle=true), which activates strictly on wide-span H_0-connected discrete-codebook manifolds (8-step minimax persistence bottleneck kappa_H0 < 10 and diameter-to-step span > 3.80, remaining exact 0.0 on patch-shift curves and disconnected image mixtures) to observe thermal equilibrium jointly over vertex-plus-simplex interior samples, guard triangle inradius margins against degenerate skinny latent simplices, and relax simplicial chord stiffness to 0.25.
mechanism_rationale: In rhbi-v9 (readout-264443fda23520da74a1fe0a), two decoupled geometric failure modes remained across the suite: (1) on vector_anisotropic (continuous MoG prior over three separated rotated anisotropic Gaussians), the 75th-quantile precision channel prec_q75 dropped <= 0 as soon as ~92.6% of fake draws entered the three modes while ~7.4% still formed inter-mode valley bridges, triggering premature thermal cooling (s_t -> 0.03 around step 400) that froze the residual bridges in place (component_covariance_error=1.5756 > 0.85), whereas perturbing Sinkhorn row-slack forces directly inside [1, 5]*ell_t disturbed normal Gaussian mode rims on ring16_acquisition; and (2) on interp_saddle_barycentric (64-particle codebook over a wide-span 2D saddle surface z = x*y), vertex-only thermal observation cooled s_t before 2-simplex barycenters settled onto the saddle sheet while unguarded triangle inradius margins pushed skinny boundary triangles off the surface (barycenter_hq=0.606 < 0.78, barycenter_surface_mae=0.111 > 0.09). Adding a dedicated signed schema-3 inter-mode valley 96th-quantile precision EMA channel (rhbi_tail_spill_gain=1.8, gated by cyclic-midpoint horizon ratio nu_val > rho=3.0 on continuous priors only) delays thermal cooling until inter-mode bridges clear without altering the continuous-prior generator loss or disturbing ring16_acquisition, mode_hold, or quantized 1D Gaussians, while wide-span macro-simplicial settling (rhbi_simplex_macro_settle=true) couples thermal observation and fatness-guarded triangle margins to the full 2-simplex interior on wide-span connected manifolds without perturbing interp_img_patch_shift or discrete image tasks.
